reason: My cousin could chase the bank for free, but he can't certify anything and I'm not flying over for a branch visit. Paying a flat fee that is a small slice of the sale money to skip the forms, CA and time zones is worth it to me, as long as it checks out.
objection: I'm moving a lot of money through a company I've never heard of. I want to see the FINTRAC number and the partner bank's name actually verify before anything moves.
would_change_my_mind: A verifiable FINTRAC registration and a named partner bank, plus a reference from someone who has moved a similar lump sum through them.
